content: January 24, 2025 CDC Contract Funding Information Key points CDC's Office of Financial Resources (OFR) processes thousands of contracts each year. OFR's contracts combine to total billions of dollars. Learn more about OFR's fiscal year contracts by year and statistics. CDC Contract Funding Allocations In fiscal year (FY) 2023, OFR processed 10,881 contract actions that totaled $7.9 billion in federal funds. The table below shows how CDC contracts are allocated among CDC's centers, institute, and offices (CIOs). The National Institute for Occupational Safety & Health (NIOSH) produced the highest number of contract actions; however, the majority of contract spending was through the National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases (NCIRD).
